description: This file contains mock implementations of socket functions used in testing, including socket creation, connection, sending, receiving, and closing. It interacts with a global mock object to simulate socket behavior in tests.

methods.name: int socket(int domain,int type,int protocol)
methods.description: Mocks the socket() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

methods.name: int connect(int sockfd,const struct sockaddr * addr,socklen_t addrlen)
methods.description: Mocks the connect() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

methods.name: ssize_t send(int sockfd,const void * buf,size_t len,int flags)
methods.description: Mocks the send() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

methods.name: int select(int nfds,fd_set * readfds,fd_set * writefds,fd_set * exceptfds,struct timeval * timeout)
methods.description: Mocks the select() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

methods.name: ssize_t recv(int sockfd,void * buf,size_t len,int flags)
methods.description: Mocks the recv() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

methods.name: int close(int sockfd)
methods.description: Mocks the close() system call by forwarding to the global mock object.

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" int connect(int sockfd, const struct sockaddr* addr, socklen_t addrlen)$/

ctags.name: recv
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" ssize_t recv(int sockfd, void *buf, size_t len, int flags)$/

ctags.name: select
ctags.signature: (int nfds,fd_set * readfds,fd_set * writefds,fd_set * exceptfds,struct timeval * timeout)

ctags.name: send
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" ssize_t send(int sockfd, const void *buf, size_t len, int flags)$/

ctags.name: socket
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" int socket(int domain, int type, int protocol)$/
